objectives.what: NEW AND NOT IN THE BRIEF: no spell could be cast anywhere in the province
objectives.result: MagicSystem.stepFall is called every frame as `M.stepFall(frame, M.groundY || 0)` and `M.groundY` is written in exactly ONE place (beginLevitation), so on a tree where nobody has levitated the ground plane of the whole world is 0. Lilmoth's quay is y=2.68, Stormhold's street is y=141.12. A body standing still in a town was therefore permanently above its ground plane, `magic.airborne` was permanently true, and `castDropReason` returns 'airborne' for every spell but slowfall: measured at town-lilmoth with focus 124/124, catalyst in hand, spark_dart attuned — INPUT_DROPPED reason:airborne, zero cast_start, zero focus spent. The same press in arena_flat casts. FOUR ROUNDS of magic measurement were taken in arenas whose floor happens to be 0, which is why nobody saw it. Fixed by asking Engine.groundInActiveCell where the floor is. Control: H.__breakGroundPlane restores the 0 and the same press in the same street is refused as airborne again.

A DOUBLE-GRAVITY HAZARD I DID NOT CLOSE. `sim/traversal.js` and `MagicSystem.stepFall` are two independent gravity implementations over the same body. With the ground plane fixed, the magic one returns on its first line for a body that is standing, which is the common case and the one that mattered; during a genuine fall in the province both still run. Before this round the magic one pulled every body in the world toward y = 0 on every frame, so this is strictly better and still not right.
